clips.title: The story
paras: In Astranaar, Raene Wolfrunner directs the Sentinels’ defense of Ashenvale. Her wolf and saber cat companions stay close as she faces Horde forces and corrupted furbolg tribes.

Raene Wolfrunner keeps watch in Astranaar with Korra, her saber cat, and Dagri, her wolf. A Sentinel officer, she oversees patrols across Ashenvale and coordinates intelligence from beyond the forest. She sends scouts such as Kaela Shadowspear into neighboring regions, including the Stonetalon Mountains.

Raene also works to counter the corruption sickening Ashenvale’s native denizens. She directs campaigns against hostile furbolg tribes, including strikes on Foulweald camps that harass travelers and efforts to remove rising Thistlefur leaders. Her scouts watch for changes in furbolg behavior. Under Raene’s command, they protect local settlements and passing travelers from coordinated ambushes.
